words.gloss: he who is inside the eyes

parts.gloss: I do not (1st person plural negative)

literal: He who is inside the eyes - lover - since he is - eyes even - I do not paint - hiding - knowing.
translation: Since my lover dwells inside my eyes, I do not even paint them with kohl, knowing it would hide him.
modern: என் காதலர் என் கண்ணுக்குள்ளேயே இருப்பதால், மை தீட்டினால் அவர் மறைந்துவிடுவார் என்று அறிந்து நான் என் கண்களுக்கு மை தீட்டவும் மாட்டேன்.
explanation: The speaker expresses her deep, constant awareness of her lover's presence by imagining that he literally resides inside her eyes. Because of this, she refuses to apply kohl (eye makeup), fearing that the dark paste would cover and hide him. The word 'எழுதேம்' refers to the traditional practice of painting the eyes, and 'கரப்பாக்கு' indicates the act of concealing. This poetic exaggeration highlights the intensity of her love and her desire to keep him always in her sight.
